nodes.label: Frozen copy taken 2026-08-03 of the desktop machine's memory file - the live directory sits on the other machine and is not reachable from here, so this copy is what there is to review. Listed unreviewed in REVIEW_REGISTER.md section 6. When a change creates, removes or redefines anything - code, concepts, schema, workflow - update the docs that describe it as part of the same change, with all docs in scope. The user does not want stale documentation: docs are part of the deliverable, and a doc that contradicts the code is a defect, not a backlog item. Before considering a change done, ask which docs its reality touches and update them in the same pass; if a doc cannot be fixed in the same pass, flag it explicitly rather than leaving it silently wrong. CANON_AUDIT.md 6.8 verdict: STALE and actively misleading on one point - the entry states 'this project uses AGENTS.md, not CLAUDE.md, as the auto-loaded brief', and there is no AGENTS.md, so an agent following it would write canon into a file nothing reads. The rule itself is grounded at 06-12: 'please do continously update information according to the things we decide' and 'did you REMOVE, quarantine, legacy-note or something else'
